extras: The free version includes limited features; MILO Pro is available with a one-time payment and lifetime licence.
intentEvidence: Store Obsidian attachments outside your vault while continuing to use normal wikilinks and embeds.
motivation: To prevent large attachment collections from making Obsidian vaults unnecessarily large.
problem: Large attachment collections can make Obsidian vaults unnecessarily large, especially when using Obsidian Sync.
summary: MILO is a multiple location manager and indexer that stores large Obsidian attachments outside the vault while resolving them seamlessly.
